_comment: Hand-curated vendor -> official website domain(s), used by .github/scripts/vendor-discovery.mjs to search a vendor's own site (shop search + sitemap) and to recognise which search results are the vendor's own pages. Keys are vendor names as Zigbee2MQTT or our device files spell them (matched case/punctuation-insensitively). Only add a domain you've confirmed is the manufacturer's own site, not a reseller. Domains learned automatically from Blakadder's mlinks are used on top of this list.
